notes.title: Brand New Update: Best of 2024 Event Quiz
notes.notes:
The holidays are here, and what better way to celebrate than with a fun-filled trivia showdown with friends and family? We've just released a free "Best of 2024" quiz for It's Quiz Time, packed with  thousands of  new questions about all the biggest events of the year!

Think you know 2024 best?  Challenge your friends and family to see who can rack up the highest score!

[b]Here's why you need this update:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]It's the ultimate party starter:[/b] Get everyone laughing and engaged with this fun and competitive quiz.
[*] [b]Something for everyone:[/b] With questions ranging from pop culture and sports to science and current events, there's something to challenge everyone from your youngest niece to your know-it-all grandpa. 😉
[*] [b]Easy to play:[/b] Up to 8 players can join in using their smartphones as controllers – no extra controllers needed!
[*] [b]Perfect for holiday gatherings:[/b] Skip the awkward small talk and bond over some friendly competition.
[*] [b]Reflect on the year that was:[/b] Remember all the highs and lows of 2024 and test your knowledge of the year's biggest moments.
[/list]

Ready to put your 2024 knowledge to the test?

Download the latest update for It's Quiz Time and you'll immediately have free access to the "Best of 2024" Event Quiz.

Happy quizzing, and have a great time with your friends & family!

- Snap Finger Click

notes.title: Maintenance update for It's Quiz Time
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

• We updated the Twitch API from Kraken (v5) to Helix

We recommend downloading this update in order to guarantee the best experience, thank you for your support!
